jobs_results.title: Practice Area Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
WHAT YOU'LL DO

We are seeking strong candidates to fill the role of a Practice Area (PA) Project Manager as part of a team of 4-5 Project Managers that is currently being built up...

In this role, you will support one or multiple Industry and Functional Practice Areas with the execution of projects that respond to an acute high-priority need, or make the Practice Areas fit for the future. In some projects you will act as an individual contributor and be part of a team, In others you will act as the project manager who drives the project content wise and/or as head of the activist “PMO” (project mgt. office).

You will be instrumental in steering and implementing strategic initiatives that are part of the CTB (Change the Business) agenda of the Global Practice Areas (PAs). This is an opportunity for you to work alongside senior leadership and cross-functional teams to enhance operational efficiency and drive innovation and strategic change. Your role will be critical in identifying challenges, crafting solutions, and leading transformative projects that align with our strategic vision at BCG.
YOU'RE GOOD AT

• Structuring and leading complex strategic and operational projects with multiple parallel work streams that routinely require independent judgement, trade-offs or prioritization
• Translating high-level strategic ideas into actionable plans
• Leading project teams by facilitating with and across both project contributors and stakeholders to achieve outcomes
• Confidently and autonomously driving to results and keeping assignments on track, while at the same time displaying flexibility in the solutioning process
• Aligning diverse (and sometimes conflicting) stakeholder interests; handling ambiguous, complex situations with poise and diplomacy
• Driving innovation with creative, pragmatic and out-of-the box thinking
• Building relationships quickly and collaborating effectively, across diverse cultural and functional backgrounds, including in non-co-located settings
• Influencing stakeholders across seniority levels to build broad support for the project outcome
• Communicating with confidence
• Understanding what creates value for the Practices AND their internal and external stakeholders
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Advanced knowledge in Outlook, PowerPoint, and Excel
YOU BRING (EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS)

• Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration or business-related field
• 6-8 years of relevant work experience
• Consulting experience at Project Leader (PL) level preferred
• Strong communication skills: ability to write clear, well-structured emails, memos and presentations and effectively lead/facilitate discussions
• Excellent analytical skills and rigor (own output and delivered quality)
• Excellent Excel proficiency – able to manage large data sets, build models
• Excellent PowerPoint proficiency
• Experience in working in international environments
• Proven ability to successfully operate in a matrix organization
• Interest in BCG Practices’ business
YOU'LL WORK WITH

The Practice Area Chief of Staff, the Global Practice Management (Senior) Directors, the Practice Area Leaders and their leadership/management teams.
A network of experts and teams across BCG functions, including the Global Practice Management Support (GPMS) team of analysts and operations specialists

jobs_results.title: Open Gateway Junior Project Manager
jobs_results.via: via Jobs At Telefónica Global - Telefónica
jobs_results.description:
Open Gateway Project Manager

AREA DESCRIPTION.

Open Gateway is a GSMA-led telco industry initiative that aims to transform communications networks into platforms. This enables open telco capabilities in an interoperable, intuitive, and programmable way.

These capabilities are exposed through global, standardized APIs under the framework of CAMARA, the open-source project led by the Linux Foundation in collaboration with the GSMA.

Integrating telco capabilities opens an infinite world of possibilities: enhanced experiences during real-time events, autonomous drone control, more secure financial services or new generation services as telesurgery with XR. These are use cases based on an initial family of Telco APIs already available to drive new experiences in areas with great potential such as optimizing connectivity, communications, security in financial services, as well as privacy and security in general.

Join the Open Gateway product team at Telefónica and play a crucial role... in building the future of the telco industry!

MISSION.

The successful candidate will be responsible for the coordination of key internal initiatives, helping in the maintenance of reporting tools and facilitating internal communication among internal units. The Open Gateway Junior Project Manager will also give support to the Product Program Manager and collaborate in building and improving internal ways of working.

MAIN DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES.
• Manage and coordinate proof of concepts.
• Follow-up and project status report
• Generate meeting notes
• Track and report internal OKRs
• Update and maintenance the reporting tool
• Provide e2e vision and make things happen

NATURE OF PROBLEMS & CHALLENGES.
• Provides oversight of organization’s projects
• Maintaining best practices within all involved teams
• Documenting and reporting project status to different stakeholder
• Identify and manage project risks and issues
• Ensure that project goals are accomplished and in line with business objectives.

EDUCATION REQUIRED.

Preferably, but not required, MSc/BSc degree in Computer Science, Telecommunication Engineering, Industrial Engineering or related technical field.

Degrees in Business Administration, Marketing or Law are also welcomed if the candidate has substantial experience with technical products.

TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE and SKILLS.
• Any Network or Telco experience will be valued.
• Teamwork, enjoy working together and open to share ideas/support.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools: PowerPoint, Excel, Word.
• Resilient, needs to understand the challenges of working within and with big organizations.
• Results oriented: Doing the job effectively and achieving the team's objectives.
• Ability to engage people from different departments
• Passionate to learn about project management

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE.
• 1 years of experience in program/project management
• Driven, self-motivated, results oriented

LANGUAGES.

Fluent in Spanish and English.

If you join us, we offer you...
• Work in a dynamic team and be part of challenging projects that will allow you to play a leading role in the transformation of the company.
• An interesting package of social benefits (luncheon vouchers, health, life and accident insurance, pension plan, flexible compensation plan...).
• A flexible working environment with hybrid models of face-to-face and telecommuting.
• Access to a wide range of continuous learning opportunities for you to grow with us.
• Participate in volunteering programmes, social actions, international mobility, off-site...

#UnidadesGlobales #CDO #OpenGate

If you join Telefónica

You join almost 100 years of history, you join a team of 106 nationalities present in more tan 35 countries. You join a team that works to connect people wherever they are. We are leading the digital revolution with the enthusiasm of the first day in all our businesses, creating the best digital ecosystem for our clients: network, IoT, cloud, security, innovation etc. Here, at Telefónica you count with everything you need to be the best you. We need people like you that wants to take this challenge of creating the Telefónica of tomorrow.

Telefonica is committed to the new working ways. Under our proposition “Disconnect to Reconnect” we have applied the Digital Disconnection.

#WeAreInclusive

We strongly believe diverse and inclusive teams become more innovative and they achieve improved results. Telefonica aims to promote and guarantee a place for everyone, just the way we are: gender, age range, sexual orientation and/or identity, culture, creed, disability or any other personal condition

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
We are looking for a highly motivated and organized Project Manager to join the Aviva team. As the Project Manager, you will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and implementing projects within the organization. You will be in charge of overseeing all aspects of a project, from the initial planning stages to the actual execution.To be successful in this role, you should have excellent organizational and communication skills. You should be able to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and collaborate with various teams and stakeholders. Additionally, you should have experience in project management, working with project management software, and developing project plans.This is a great opportunity for someone who is looking to take their career to the next level. If you have a passion for project management and are ready to take on a new challenge, we'd love to have you join our team.

Responsibilities:

Plan and coordinate project activities, including setting milestones... developing project plans, and creating budgets.
Monitor and track project progress, including progress towards goals and deadlines.
Develop and maintain effective communication channels with stakeholders, including internal teams, external partners, and clients.
Lead and manage project team members to ensure tasks are completed on time and within budget.
Identify and mitigate potential project risks.
Manage project resources, including personnel, equipment, and materials.
Prepare project status reports and provide feedback to stakeholders.
Develop and maintain project documentation, including project plans, specifications, and test results.
Work with stakeholders to ensure project objectives are met.
Use project management software to track and manage project activities.

Aviva is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics

jobs_results.title: Marketing Services Project Manager Intern
jobs_results.description:
Back Market is the world’s leading refurbished electronics marketplace with a team of 650 people, powering operations in 21 countries (and counting!).

Named one of the World's Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company in 2019 and again in 2021, our mission is simple: empowering people to consume tech sustainably by offering folks a high quality, accessible, and more eco-friendly alternative to buying new electronics. Why? Refurbished tech helps lower our collective environmental impact. We have indeed contributed to avoid the production of more than 1,000,000 tons of CO2e worldwide since our launch in 2014.

Be part of an exciting and growing international adventure that will change the way the world consumes tech.

We are looking for an intern to join the Marketing Services team for 6 months.

The Marketing Services team aims at creating & developing projects that change consumer perception of refurbished electronics, demonstrating their value and reliability. The internship will... focus on the Marketing Services stream "New offers", developing new offers that build trust and affordability in refurbished tech, particularly through partnerships with telecommunications companies and premium offers that remove the uncertainty associated with refurbished tech.
Your Mission (If You Accept It): 🥇
• Participate in the project management, coordinating with internal stakeholders and external partners
• Prepare reports and analyze data to understand the performance of our projects and make recommendations for improvement
• Help with the communication across internal and external teams
• Contribute to strategic research on current and future offers (benchmark, competitors analysis)
You’re At The Right Place If: ⭐
• Bachelor/Master degree in Business, Marketing or Engineering
• You have some experience in project management: you have already participated in planning projects and supported their monitoring
• You have good communication skills and like to collaborate with cross-functional teams
• You like to analyze data and problem-solving
• You have a customer-centric mindset: you are keen to understand customer needs and preferences, and try to use their feedback to suggest improvements
• You are a Tech savvy and would like to discover more about the refurbished tech
• You speak French and English fluently
About the internship: ⚡️
• Starting date: July/August 2024
• Duration: 6 months
• Full-time role (35H/week)
• Location: Barcelona, Spain
• Contract: You must have an internship agreement provided by your current school
Recruitment process: 🚦
• HR Interview with the Talent Acquisition Specialist (30 min)
• Technical test (home assignment)
• Skills and Team fit interview with the direct manager and another person in the team (1h)
WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

- A meaningful job: through hard work, you will help avoid thousands of tons of electronic waste and fight against planned obsolescence. It counts!
- An attractive salary, multiple benefits (meal tickets, health insurance, etc...), internal events, etc…
- Be in an environment where you can make a difference: you will have the freedom to innovate and adopt new ideas!
- A booming scale-up: our environment is rapidly growing in Europe, the USA and in Asia!
- We embrace work life balance which includes flexible working hours and the opportunity to work from home.
- A lot of fun: you will have the opportunity to work in a fast-paced, open-minded and friendly environment.

Back Market is an Equal Opportunity Employer for any minority, disability, gender identity or sexual orientation.

Back Market is helping to address one of the biggest challenges of our time: climate change. We take this so seriously that we were awarded status as a “Société à Mission”, or company with a social mission, by the French government. We know we can’t tackle a global problem without a globally representative team so we are committed to embedding diversity, equity and inclusion principles in every aspect of our organization. But more importantly, being One Loving & Free Spirited Tribe is in our DNA as it is one of the five foundational values of our company since we got started way back in 2014. We are committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We know our lofty goals cannot be reached unless everyone has a seat at the table along with the resources and opportunity to grow

jobs_results.title: Project Management Office / PMO Manager
jobs_results.company_name: Radisson Hotel Group, Madrid Office-Information Technology
jobs_results.description:
Mission:
The Project Management Office (PMO) manager mission is to introduce, maintain & measure a consistent approach to managing projects. It oversees the administration of projects to ensure support of the standards, methodology and technology defined by the IT organization.

Role purpose:
Primary role of the PMO manager is to apply a set of supporting activities for the consumption of both the Project Management teams as well as governance & reporting for Radisson’s IT senior management, in line with the goals set by the Transformation Office Lead. This will include application of practical management controls that support improved project/organizational performance.

Responsibilities:
Play a key role in implementing the company’s project management governance and methodologies for the project
• Drive adoption of best practices among project management community
• Own documentation strategy
• Provide key project analysis to key stakeholders
• Maintain and update project management... controlling & reporting tools; deliver senior-level status reports to the steering committees
• Maintain documentation for projects including tracking of risks, action logs and project deliverables (as needed)
• Assure initial quality on received data inputs based on given guidelines
• Report on project performance and KPIs
• Provide other PMO support to project managers such as vendor & contract management, cost management, resource management.
• Strategy: Define and drive the IT project management best practices within the Corporate domains with the Transformation Office Lead to support the 5 Year Plan initiative and EMMA – RHG’s Corporate Global Platform.
• Solution Design: Ensure that the internal and external Business Relationship Managers and Project managers adopt to the solution design processes and templates defined by the Transformation/Project Management Office.

RHG’s Corporate ideal PMO shows:
• Ability to connect the dots through a Stakeholder’s eyes with a keen ability to sift through the clutter of data to articulate the business strategy and the alignment of prioritized IT initiatives to achieve it faster, more efficiently and with a measurable outcome.
• Strong consulting, facilitation and negotiation experience, preferably with external customers.
• Succinct executive level verbal and written business communication in non-IT lingo.
• Analytical skills to measure and drive key business decisions on process & systems to enable the overall company success.
• Corporate Industry knowledge or similar one
• Sound knowledge of Project Management methodology and function
• Ability to drive multiple program stream status updates, action and RAID logs
• Excellent attention to details, accuracy and analytical mindset
• Ability to deliver through matrix organizations.
• Solid & extensive vendor management skills
• Strong program/project management skills

Requirements:
Preferred but not required bachelor's degree in computer science or information systems
Minimum experience: +5 years in Global / Area / Regional IT Management role, +5 years relevant experience working in capacity of a PMO / Project Manager, +2 years experience on IT vendor management
At least 10 years of multi-disciplined IT experience including:
• Proven experience in a PMO role
• Experience implementing new project management practices or reviewing / improving existing processes and templates
• Experience in software development or implementation project life cycle
• Experience in large sophisticated IT organizations with high volume/high transaction environment.
• Regional/Global management experience and teaming experience including line management.
• Experience working in a fast-past environment with a strong ability to show initiative
• Experience in writing documents, preparing process workflows, doing professional ppt decks/papers/minutes to a high standard
• Advanced user level experience with MS Office (Excel, Access, PowerPoint)
• Exposure to both change management and business analysis
• Strong in processing complex tasks quickly working with Agile methodologies
• Ability to deliver through matrix organizations.
• Solid & extensive vendor management skills.
• Strong program/project management skills
Soft skills:
• Making customers more successful: Customer-oriented mind-set, capable of maintaining relationships & build trust at director level & above across multiple stakeholders, goal-oriented individual.
• Shaping direction: strategic oriented individual, capable of envisioning, developing, aligning and communicating the processes and tools to execute successful projects and initiatives
• Performance: High performance individual, who takes responsibilities & deliver towards them, by coordinating effort and aligning resources to achieve objectives.
• Communication: Clear communication view, able to adapt it to the audience (technical, manager, executive), internal or external), in a variety of format presentation settings: one to one, small and large groups, with peers etc.
• Change management: Able to act as a change agent, initiating, sponsoring, enabling and driving transformative changes of strategic significance. Help drive the deployment and adoption of the industry best practices across the organization.
English at negotiation level as a minimum.

#LI-DM1

Compensation: To be discussed

• Provide other PMO support to project managers such as vendor & contract management, cost management, resource management.
• Strategy: Define and drive the IT project management best practices within the Corporate domains with the Transformation Office Lead to support the 5 Year Plan initiative and EMMA – RHG’s Corporate Global Platform.
• Solution Design: Ensure that the internal and external Business Relationship Managers and Project managers adopt to the solution design processes and templates defined by the Transformation/Project Management Office.

RHG’s Corporate ideal PMO shows:
• Ability to connect the dots through a Stakeholder’s eyes with a keen ability to sift through the clutter of data to articulate the business strategy and the alignment of prioritized IT initiatives to achieve it faster, more efficiently and with a measurable outcome.
• Strong consulting, facilitation and negotiation experience, preferably with external customers.
• Succinct executive level verbal and written business communication in non-IT lingo.
• Analytical skills to measure and drive key business decisions on process & systems to enable the overall company success.
• Corporate Industry knowledge or similar one
• Sound knowledge of Project Management methodology and function
• Ability to drive multiple program stream status updates, action and RAID logs
• Excellent attention to details, accuracy and analytical mindset
• Ability to deliver through matrix organizations.
• Solid & extensive vendor management skills
• Strong program/project management skills

Requirements:
Preferred but not required bachelor's degree in computer science or information systems
Minimum experience: +5 years in Global / Area / Regional IT Management role, +5 years relevant experience working in capacity of a PMO / Project Manager, +2 years experience on IT vendor management
At least 10 years of multi-disciplined IT experience including:
• Proven experience in a PMO role
• Experience implementing new project management practices or reviewing / improving existing processes and templates
• Experience in software development or implementation project life cycle
• Experience in large sophisticated IT organizations with high volume/high transaction environment.
• Regional/Global management experience and teaming experience including line management.
• Experience working in a fast-past environment with a strong ability to show initiative
• Experience in writing documents, preparing process workflows, doing professional ppt decks/papers/minutes to a high standard
• Advanced user level experience with MS Office (Excel, Access, PowerPoint)
• Exposure to both change management and business analysis
• Strong in processing complex tasks quickly working with Agile methodologies
• Ability to deliver through matrix organizations.
• Solid & extensive vendor management skills.
• Strong program/project management skills
Soft skills:
• Making customers more successful: Customer-oriented mind-set, capable of maintaining relationships & build trust at director level & above across multiple stakeholders, goal-oriented individual.
• Shaping direction: strategic oriented individual, capable of envisioning, developing, aligning and communicating the processes and tools to execute successful projects and initiatives
• Performance: High performance individual, who takes responsibilities & deliver towards them, by coordinating effort and aligning resources to achieve objectives.
• Communication: Clear communication view, able to adapt it to the audience (technical, manager, executive), internal or external), in a variety of format presentation settings: one to one, small and large groups, with peers etc.
• Change management: Able to act as a change agent, initiating, sponsoring, enabling and driving transformative changes of strategic significance. Help drive the deployment and adoption of the industry best practices across the organization.
English at negotiation level as a minimum.

#LI-DM1

Compensation: To be discussed

jobs_results.title: Certification Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
About Us

Always open. Our code, our culture, our opportunities. Leading open innovation without limits. We are SUSE.

SUSE is a global leader in innovative, reliable and secure enterprise open source solutions, including SUSE Linux Enterprise (SLE), Rancher and NeuVector. More than 60% of the Fortune 500 rely on SUSE to power their mission-critical workloads, enabling them to innovate everywhere – from the data center to the cloud, to the edge and beyond. SUSE puts the “open” back in open source, collaborating with partners and communities to give customers the agility to tackle innovation challenges today and the freedom to evolve their strategy and solutions tomorrow.

We are open in our roots and open in our approach, striving to be the most trusted open innovator in the World. Openness extends beyond our technology. Our vibrant community thrives on diversity and connectivity without borders.
Certification Project Manager

Job Description

As a Certification Project Manager, you... will have the opportunity to meaningfully impact how our organization scales by attaining certification compliance of SUSE products portfolio in accordance with industry production standards in security and conformance defined by worldwide established bodies such as ISO, NIST, BSI, PCI, as well as other national certification bodies. Join industry-leading professionals to ensure that our processes, infrastructure, and products are designed, operated, maintained and protected in accordance with these certifications and security standards as it applies to SUSE. This role reports to SUSE’s Head of Solutions Certification and will work closely with Engineering, Product Management, Legal, Pre-Sales and Marketing.

Summary:

You are responsible for establishing and persistently maintaining certified production compliance status for portfolio of chosen SUSE products and their relevant certifications. You drive the design and implementation of corresponding compliance frameworks, define delivery milestones and track their progress.

Responsibilities:
• Driving certification cycles projects for our enterprise products and organization
• Defining milestones and tracking their progress
• Liaising common grounds across Engineering, PM, consultants, and partners
• Coordinating compliance requirements across different teams
• Organizing events and workshops necessary for relevant knowledge sharing
• Organizing cycle process documentation and keeping it in accurate up to date state
• Communicating with certification labs and authorities, primarily in Germany and the US
• Filing and tracking relevant application paperwork
• Communication with external and internal customers

Candidate Profile:
• 5+ years of total experience in software product development industry
• Minimum 1 year of which in managing product and organization certification compliance to security, conformance, or safety standards from ISO, CCRA / Common Criteria, NIST / FIPS or other standardisation bodies
• Strong skills in process handling and documentation frameworks, such as MS/Open/Libre Office, Confluence/Jira, etc
• Good knowledge about certification bodies (e.g. BSI, NIST, NIAP, ANSSI) and their typical requirements
• Passion for organized paperwork and skills of keeping large sets of information pieces in systematic manner
• Project management level in GPM/PMP/IPMA (minimal ‘D’, ‘C’ or ‘B’ is a plus) or equivalent
• Excellent communication and 'soft' skills
• Excellent communication level of English (German language skills is a plus)
• Familiarity with Linux operating system

What makes us different:
• You will find and can connect to highly skilled engineers at SUSE
• We provide many different products and endless opportunities to learn
• We help our employees to develop
• We work with, support, maintain, and advocate open-source!
• You can work with and within an international team
• Our working hours are as flexible as can be any team-work from home!
• We organize regular events (hackathons, workshops, outdoor events, etc) to build up relationships and friendship within and across teams
• At SUSE the opinion of the employee matters!
• SUSE is a growing company, with great products, a culture that fosters openness and friendship, and where many opportunities exist
• SUSE has more than two decades of experience in maintaining industrial grade security and bespoke product compliance to make our products outstanding

If you are successful for this position you'll have to pass pre-employment checks before joining us. The content of these checks may vary by country.

Job
Quality

What We Offer

We empower you to be bold, driving your career to create the future you want. We celebrate and reward your achievements. 

SUSE is a dynamic environment that is evolving rapidly, thus requiring agility, strong entrepreneurship and an open mind.

This is a compelling opportunity for the right person to join us as we continue to scale and prosper.  

If you’re a big thinker, obsessed by execution and thrive in a dynamic environment in which you can tangibly create a lasting legacy, then please apply now! 

We give you the freedom to be yourself. You will work in a global community of unique individuals – like you – with different backgrounds, talents, skills and perspectives. A truly open community where everyone is welcome, has a voice and is encouraged to reach their full potential regardless of age, gender, race, nationality, disability, sexual orientation, religion, or any other characteristics.  

Sounds like the right fit for you? Click Apply to submit your resume. A recruiter will contact you if your skills match our current or any future positions. In the meantime, stay updated on the latest SUSE news and job vacancies by joining our Talent Community.

SUSE Values
• We are passionate about customers 
• We are respectful and inclusive 
• We are empowered and accountable  
• We are trustworthy and act with integrity 
• We are collaborative 
• We are SUSE

jobs_results.title: R&D Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
R&D Project Manager
Take your next career step at ABB with a global team that is energizing the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future.

At ABB, we have the clear goal of driving diversity and inclusion across all dimensions: gender, LGBTQ+, abilities, ethnicity and generations. Together, we are embarking on a journey where each and every one of us, individually and collectively, welcomes and celebrates individual differences.

The R&D Project Manager plays an important role within the R&D team.
You will oversee R&D Projects within the AMR GSC(Spain), providing clear guidelines, tasks and milestones, while motivating and providing feedback to R&D Manager.
In this role, you will manage R&D roadmap projects under ABB's Phase & Gate model.
This position is not graded yet as the country still hasn´t gone through the phase 4 of Global Grading process.
This is a position with global grade

99
This position reports to

R&D Department Lead
Your... responsibilities
• Planning and ensuring an optimal project portfolio for the team, and overseeing efficient project execution.
• Managing the development of project planning documents with ABB Phase & Gate Model.
• Monitoring projects to ensure best practices in cost control, resource efficiency.
• Analyzing and addressing project risks, and regularly disseminating lessons learned.
• Achieving project deliverables and compliance with roadmap and project requirements.
• Building strong relationships with subcontractors and R&D teams to execute the projects of R&D roadmap.

Your background
• 2 years of experience in Project Management, working as Project Manager in R&D projects or project management with similar characteristics.
• Sound knowledge of PMP and the robotics or Industrial market.
• Knowledge of Microsoft Project.
• A solution-focused approach and strong written and spoken communication skills.
• An Industrial Engineer or Engineer in Project Management.
• Spanish and English languages (required) will be additionally valued Chinese.

Benefits
• Meal allowance
• Flexible work practices
• Company mobile phone
• Wellbeing program
• Employee Share Acquisition Plan
More about us

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

Work model: hybrid #LI-hybrid

jobs_results.description:

About our European Projects Office

Our European Projects Office was created in mid 2010 as a strategic bet of Gradiant towards the participation in cooperative research and innovation activities at EU level. fourteen years after, Gradiant counts over 40 participations in FP7, H2020 and Horizon Europe projects, some of them as coordinator. Throughout these years Gradiant has established itself as a competitive RTO at EU level, and an innovation lighthouse at national level. Additionally, we have positioned ourselves as an active player across the ICT sector within a number of European Innovation Alliances, Industrial Associations, European Innovation Partnerships and Technology Platforms.

We are committed to keep along this track and want to address new exciting challenges and opportunities ahead of us, but we need help.
What are we looking for

We are seeking someone who can help us grow by bringing in their experience and know-how in EU funding, along with some... knowledge of digital and communication technologies, contacts, energy and enthusiasm. Be ready to fit in our fresh, tech-savvy work atmosphere where a team of young, brilliant technologists and our dynamic management will bring you plenty of opportunities to take leadership and generate impact.

Your main responsabilities will be:

EU-sponsored R&D Project Development
• Identification of new opportunities within EU Institutions and EU Programmes: Horizon Europe, DIGITAL Europe, EIC and others
• To promote the participation of Gradiant in new Research and Innovation initiatives
• Support the active participation of Gradiant in EU-wide initiatives such as EU Partnerships, industry associations and other strategic alliances
• To represent Gradiant at EU events, EU initiatives

Strategic planning
• Matching Gradiant capacities & interests to EU Programmes & Calls
• Follow-up of EU legislation and EC rules relevant for EU projects
• Permanent update on EU Research Programmes and Calls relevant for Gradiant

Supervision and coordination of the preparation of new project proposals in collaboration with Gradiant’s Technical Areas.
• Interaction with the funding Organizations (EC and others)
• Consortium building
• To participate in the generation and screening of new project ideas
• Proposal planning, coordination and writing
• To adapt the whole proposal to the Call requirements and guidelines
• To review the coherence and quality of the proposals
• Identification and management of the Department's resources for project preparation.
• Fulfillment of deadlines
What we want from you
• A higher educational degree, preferably Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Science or Physics
• +2 years of working experience, preferentially in EU project writing & management in technology field
• Knowledge of the functioning of the European Commission policies and funding schemes for research and innovation
• Excellent spoken and outstanding written English. Good knowledge of other European languages is a plus
• To meet strict deadlines, to multi-task, to synthesize information & provide analysis, to work in a multicultural environment

Other skills to be considered:
• Negociation, adaptability, strategic thinking and organisational skills.
What we offer

💶 Salary: From 26.000€SBA + % variable depending on your knowledge, experience and desire!

🏖️ 23 days of holidays + your birthday + 24th and 31st of December, you will have 26 days of holidays!

🤪#TroulaDays What's this? At Gradiant you'll be able to choose one Friday off a month, so you can switch off and enjoy a longer weekend.

👩🏻‍💻 Teleworking and office. Decide how and when you want to work with your team to strike a balance.

📙 Personal training budget. We want to help you improve your technical skills, feel involved in the tech community and develop your soft skills to lead teams and/or lead projects.

💻 We will provide you with all the necessary equipment so that you can work comfortably.
Plus

🎁 Welcome Pack

💰 Flexible salary. Today, we offer various services through flexible pay, restaurant vouchers, childcare, transport, medical insurance...

⚖️ Work-life balance. Your work-life balance is really important to us.

👕 Our culture is our goal: a working environment where horizontal communication is our maxim.

🌟Continuous training. We like to exchange knowledge, so we offer internal training courses in which you can participate as an assistant or driver!

🍏Coming to the office has endless advantages, including enjoying fresh fruit and a good coffee with your colleagues every day.

Find out more about Gradiant

At Gradiant we work to incorporate ICT into the processes and products of companies. We develop technological solutions from the point of view of connectivity, intelligence and security to work hand in hand with the industry around us.

Our values are underpinned by a horizontal organisation, where teamwork allows us to build an inclusive and respectful workplace, where each member of the group freely uses their experience and expertise to carry out quality and creative work.

We love what we do! We believe in technology as a source of progress and in creativity as a fundamental value for technological development. Adding value through innovation is one of our fundamental pillars to increase your competitiveness through digital transformation.
